concepts.gloss_en: Speech/utterance — the divine speech, 'ruach piv' of the Holy One, aspect of Malchut/mouth and gevurot; plural = the utterances

members.note: representative; speech as ruach piv, Malchut peh, gevurot
morphological plural of the same noun 'speech/utterance'; same underlying concept, differing only in number

notes: Singular/plural of the same common noun 'speech'. Tiered 'likely' rather than 'obvious' because it is a morphological (not purely orthographic) variant, and the lm2:79 proof context does not itself foreground the word; no evidence of a distinct referent, so a single concept is appropriate.
